copy.helptools.the_medical_lead_reviews_.amharic: የሕክምና መሪው የአገልግሎት መግለጫን፣ የማስረጃ መስፈርቶችንና የተደገፉ ሂደቶችን ይገምግማል። ረቂቅ አገልግሎት ማመልከቻ ሊቀበል ይችላል፤ ሥራ ለመሥራት ፈቃድ አይሰጥም።
copy.helptools.the_medical_lead_reviews_.afaan_oromo: Hoogganaan yaalaa hiika tajaajilaa, ulaagaa ragaa fi adeemsa deeggarame gamaaggama. Tajaajilli wixinee iyyata fudhachuu danda’a; hojii hojjechuuf hin hayyamu.

copy.helptools.open_one_service_applicat.english: Open one service application. Review its qualifications and private evidence. A resume describes experience; a License or registration document supports the credential check. Documents must be attached to this particular scope.
copy.helptools.open_one_service_applicat.amharic: አንድ የአገልግሎት ማመልከቻ ይክፈቱ። ብቃቶችንና የግል ማስረጃን ይገምግሙ። የሥራ ልምድ ሰነድ ልምድን ይገልጻል፤ የፈቃድ ወይም ምዝገባ ሰነድ ማረጋገጫን ይደግፋል። ሰነዶች ከዚህ ማመልከቻ ጋር መያያዝ አለባቸው።
copy.helptools.open_one_service_applicat.afaan_oromo: Iyyata tajaajila tokko bani. Barnootaa fi ragaa dhuunfaa gamaaggami. CV muuxannoo ibsa; galmeen hayyamaa ykn galmee mirkaneessa deeggara. Galmeewwan iyyata kanaaf maxxanfamuu qabu.

copy.helptools.check_the_issuing_authori.english: Check the issuing authority yourself. Record the source, actual check date, source reference and uploaded license document. A source reference identifies the registry record or your documented check; it is not a password. Do not mark a credential verified merely because a file was uploaded.
copy.helptools.check_the_issuing_authori.amharic: ሰጪውን ባለሥልጣን በራስዎ ያረጋግጡ። ምንጩን፣ ትክክለኛ የማረጋገጫ ቀንን፣ የምንጭ ማጣቀሻንና የተጫነውን የፈቃድ ሰነድ ይመዝግቡ። ማጣቀሻው የምዝገባ መዝገብ ወይም የማረጋገጫ መዝገብ ነው፤ የይለፍ ቃል አይደለም። ሰነድ መጫን ብቻ ማረጋገጥ አይደለም።
copy.helptools.check_the_issuing_authori.afaan_oromo: Qaama ragaa kenne ofii keetiin sakatta’i. Madda, guyyaa sakatta’iinsaa dhugaa, wabii fi galmee hayyamaa galmeessi. Wabiin galmee kuusaa ykn sakatta’iinsa kee adda baasa; jecha iccitii miti. Galmeen olkaa’amuu qofti mirkaneessa miti.

copy.helptools.complete_every_score_and_.english: Complete every score and explain its rationale. Document references beside scores are optional. Mandatory identity, credential, qualification, adult-care, experience and interview checks must pass; high scores cannot compensate for missing requirements.
copy.helptools.complete_every_score_and_.amharic: እያንዳንዱን ነጥብ ያስገቡና ምክንያቱን ይግለጹ። ከነጥቦች ጎን ያሉ ማጣቀሻዎች አማራጭ ናቸው። የማንነት፣ የፈቃድ፣ የብቃት፣ የአዋቂ እንክብካቤ፣ የልምድና የቃለ መጠይቅ መስፈርቶች መሟላት አለባቸው። ከፍተኛ ነጥብ የጎደለ መስፈርትን አይተካም።
copy.helptools.complete_every_score_and_.afaan_oromo: Qabxii hunda guutiitii sababaa ibsi. Wabiin ragaa qabxii biratti filannoo dha. Ulaagaaleen eenyummaa, hayyama, barnoota, kunuunsa ga’eessotaa, muuxannoo fi gaaffii dirqamaa darbuu qabu. Qabxiin ol’aanaan ulaagaa dhabame hin bakka bu’u.

copy.helptools.approve_only_when_the_evi.english: Approve only when the evidence and requirements pass. Request information when evidence is missing: clear unfinished verification, choose Request information and state what is needed. The applicant can then edit, upload documents and resubmit. Reject with a meaningful reason when requirements are not met.
copy.helptools.approve_only_when_the_evi.amharic: ማስረጃና መስፈርቶች ሲሟሉ ብቻ ያጽድቁ። ማስረጃ ከጎደለ ያልተጠናቀቀውን ማረጋገጫ አጽድተው መረጃ ይጠይቁና የሚያስፈልገውን ይግለጹ። አመልካቹ ማስተካከል፣ ሰነድ መጫንና እንደገና ማስገባት ይችላል። መስፈርቶች ካልተሟሉ ግልጽ ምክንያት ሰጥተው ውድቅ ያድርጉ።
copy.helptools.approve_only_when_the_evi.afaan_oromo: Ragaa fi ulaagaan yoo darban qofa hayyami. Ragaan yoo dhabame sakatta’iinsa hin xumuramne qulqulleessii odeeffannoo gaafadhu; waan barbaachisu ibsi. Iyyataan sirreessuu, galmee olkaa’uu fi deebi’ee erguu danda’a. Ulaagaan yoo hin guutamne sababaa ifaan didi.

copy.helptools.each_approved_scope_permi.english: Each approved scope permits matching offerings. The clinician publishes an offering and availability before discovery or requests. Expired or revoked approval blocks new bookings; existing appointments remain preserved for operational review. Vetting permissions never grant private patient-record access.
copy.helptools.each_approved_scope_permi.amharic: እያንዳንዱ የጸደቀ አገልግሎት ተዛማጅ አቅርቦትን ይፈቅዳል። ባለሙያው በፍለጋና በጥያቄዎች ለመገኘት አቅርቦትና ጊዜ ሰሌዳ ማተም አለበት። ያለፈ ወይም የተሻረ ፈቃድ አዲስ ቀጠሮን ይከለክላል፤ የቀድሞ መዝገቦች ይቀመጣሉ። የግምገማ ፈቃድ የታካሚ መዝገብ መዳረሻ አይሰጥም።
copy.helptools.each_approved_scope_permi.afaan_oromo: Tajaajilli hayyamame tokkoon tokkoon dhiyeessii isaa hayyama. Ogeessi argamuu fi gaaffii fudhachuuf dhiyeessii fi yeroo isaa maxxansa. Hayyamni yeroon darbe ykn haqame beellama haaraa ni dhorka; galmeen duraanii ni tura. Hayyamni gamaaggamaa qaqqabummaa galmee dhukkubsataa hin kennu.

copy.helptools.guidance_for_this_workspa.english: Guidance for this workspace. Help never submits a form or records a decision.
copy.helptools.guidance_for_this_workspa.amharic: ለዚህ የሥራ ቦታ መመሪያ። እገዛ ቅጽ አያስገባም ወይም ውሳኔ አይመዘግብም።
copy.helptools.guidance_for_this_workspa.afaan_oromo: Qajeelfama bakka hojii kanaa. Gargaarsi unka hin ergu ykn murtii hin galmeessu.

copy.helptools.use_this_guide_while_revi.english: Use this guide while reviewing. All final decisions remain human decisions.
copy.helptools.use_this_guide_while_revi.amharic: በግምገማ ወቅት ይህን መመሪያ ይጠቀሙ። ሁሉም የመጨረሻ ውሳኔዎች በሰው ይወሰናሉ።
copy.helptools.use_this_guide_while_revi.afaan_oromo: Gamaaggama keessatti qajeelfama kana fayyadami. Murtiin xumuraa hundi kan namaa ti.

copy.helptools.reduce_motion_in_public_p.english: Reduce motion in public pages here. Your device’s reduced-motion setting always takes priority.

copy.helptools.finish_the_current_protec.english: Finish the current protected step before starting a tour. You can still read help here.
copy.helptools.finish_the_current_protec.amharic: ጉብኝቱን ከመጀመር በፊት ያለውን ደረጃ ያጠናቅቁ። እገዛውን እዚህ ማንበብ ይችላሉ።
copy.helptools.finish_the_current_protec.afaan_oromo: Daawwannaa jalqabuu dura tarkaanfii ammaa xumuri. Gargaarsa asitti dubbisuu dandeessa.

copy.helptools.learn_the_main_controls_w.english: Learn the main controls without changing any records.
copy.helptools.learn_the_main_controls_w.afaan_oromo: Galmee tokko illee osoo hin jijjiirin to’annoo ijoo baradhu.

copy.helptools.save_your_changes_before_.english: Save your changes before starting a tour. Help articles remain available.
copy.helptools.save_your_changes_before_.amharic: ጉብኝት ከመጀመርዎ በፊት ለውጦችዎን ያስቀምጡ። የእገዛ መመሪያዎች ይገኛሉ።
copy.helptools.save_your_changes_before_.afaan_oromo: Daawwannaa jalqabuu dura jijjiirama kee olkaa’i. Qajeelfamni gargaarsaa ni jira.

copy.helptools.application_review_privat.english: Application review, private evidence, credential checks, scope decisions and correction workflows.
copy.helptools.application_review_privat.amharic: የማመልከቻ ግምገማ፣ የግል ማስረጃ፣ ማረጋገጫ፣ ውሳኔና እርማት ሂደቶች።
copy.helptools.application_review_privat.afaan_oromo: Gamaaggama iyyataa, ragaa dhuunfaa, mirkaneessa, murtii fi adeemsa sirreeffamaa.

copy.helptools.clinicians_apply_for_each.english: Clinicians apply for each service separately. Upload private documents in Professional review, save the draft, then submit. If information is requested, open the application, correct it and resubmit. Approval is always manual.
copy.helptools.clinicians_apply_for_each.amharic: ባለሙያዎች ለእያንዳንዱ አገልግሎት ለየብቻ ያመለክታሉ። በሙያ ግምገማ የግል ሰነዶችን ጫኑ፣ ረቂቁን አስቀምጡና አስገቡ። መረጃ ከተጠየቀ ማመልከቻውን ክፈቱ፣ አስተካክሉና እንደገና አስገቡ። ፈቃድ ሁልጊዜ በሰው ይወሰናል።
copy.helptools.clinicians_apply_for_each.afaan_oromo: Ogeessonni tajaajila tokkoon tokkoof addaan iyyatu. Gamaaggama ogummaa keessatti galmee dhuunfaa olkaa’i, wixinee olkaa’iitii ergi. Odeeffannoon yoo gaafatame iyyata bani, sirreessiitii deebi’ii ergi. Hayyamni yeroo hunda namaan murtaa’a.

copy.helptools.for_sign_in_use_an_enable.english: For sign-in, use an enabled code-delivery method or choose password access. A code proves contact possession, not professional approval.
copy.helptools.for_sign_in_use_an_enable.amharic: ለመግባት የተነቃ የኮድ መላኪያ ዘዴ ወይም የይለፍ ቃል ይምረጡ። ኮድ የመገናኛ ባለቤትነትን ያረጋግጣል፤ የሙያ ፈቃድ አይደለም።
copy.helptools.for_sign_in_use_an_enable.afaan_oromo: Seenuuf mala koodii ergamuu baname fayyadami ykn jecha iccitii filadhu. Koodiin abbummaa quunnamtii mirkaneessa; hayyama ogummaa miti.

copy.historydocuments.some_files_could_n.english: Some files could not be uploaded. Retry those files individually.
copy.historydocuments.some_files_could_n.amharic: አንዳንድ ፋይሎች አልተሰቀሉም። በተናጠል ዳግም ይሞክሩ።
copy.historydocuments.some_files_could_n.afaan_oromo: Faayiloonni tokko tokko hin olkaaʼamne. Tokko tokkoon irra deebiʼi.

copy.historydocuments.document_could_not.english: Document could not be removed. Try again.
copy.historydocuments.document_could_not.afaan_oromo: Sanadichi hin haqamne. Irra deebiʼi yaali.

copy.historydocuments.drag_history_docum.english: Drag history documents here, or select files

copy.historydocuments.pdf_jpeg_or_png_up.english: PDF, JPEG or PNG. Up to 5 MB per file.
copy.historydocuments.pdf_jpeg_or_png_up.amharic: PDF፣ JPEG ወይም PNG። ለእያንዳንዱ ፋይል እስከ 5 MB።
copy.historydocuments.pdf_jpeg_or_png_up.afaan_oromo: PDF, JPEG ykn PNG. Faayilii tokkoof hanga 5 MB.

copy.historydocuments.uploading_keeps_fi.english: Uploading keeps files private. Choose individual files later in the encounter sharing preview. Removing your copy revokes future access;previously shared snapshots are retained for governance review.

copy.historydocuments.your_documents_cou.english: Your documents could not be loaded. Try again.
copy.historydocuments.your_documents_cou.afaan_oromo: Sanadoonni kee hin feʼamne. Irra deebiʼi yaali.

copy.interactiveproducttour.explore_a_gu.english: Explore a guided workspace with illustrative people and appointments. This tour creates no accounts, bookings or payments.

copy.interactiveproducttour.choose_a_ser.english: Choose a service to see how booking works.

copy.interactiveproducttour.in_a_real_bo.english: In a real booking, review the exact identity, history and individually selected files shared with your treating clinician.

copy.interactiveproducttour.show_my_name.english: Show My Name in This Tour

copy.interactiveproducttour.text_history.english: Text history and individual files remain separate choices.

copy.interactiveproducttour.real_booking.english: Real bookings recheck approval, availability, sharing and funds before reserving your appointment.

copy.interactiveproducttour.a_focused_vi.english: A focused view of your practice, appointments and next actions.

copy.interactiveproducttour.set_recurrin.english: Set recurring hours while protecting existing appointments.

copy.interactiveproducttour.only_eligibl.english: Only eligible clinicians receive the patient-authorized disclosure. Other clinicians never see your quote.

copy.interactiveproducttour.no_camera_or.english: No Camera or Microphone Access in This Tour

copy.offeracceptance.only_this_treating_.english: Only this treating clinician receives your selected history and files.
copy.offeracceptance.only_this_treating_.amharic: የመረጡትን ታሪክ እና ፋይሎች ይህ ባለሙያ ብቻ ያገኛል።
copy.offeracceptance.only_this_treating_.afaan_oromo: Seenaa fi faayiloota filatte ogeessi kun qofti argata.

copy.offeracceptance.your_saved_text_his.amharic: ሲቀበሉ የተቀመጠው የጽሑፍ ታሪክዎ ለዚህ ባለሙያ ይጋራል።
copy.offeracceptance.your_saved_text_his.afaan_oromo: Yeroo fudhattan seenaan barruu olkaa’ame ogeessa kanaaf ni qoodama.

copy.offeracceptance.your_saved_text_his.english: Your saved text history stays private.
copy.offeracceptance.your_saved_text_his.amharic: የተቀመጠው የጽሑፍ ታሪክዎ የግል ሆኖ ይቆያል።

copy.offeracceptance.the_sharing_preview.english: The sharing preview is unavailable. This offer may have expired.
copy.offeracceptance.the_sharing_preview.amharic: የማጋራት ቅድመ ዕይታ አይገኝም። የአማራጩ ጊዜ አልፎ ሊሆን ይችላል።
copy.offeracceptance.the_sharing_preview.afaan_oromo: Durargiin qoodinsaa hin jiru. Yeroon dhiyeessichaa darbuu dandaʼa.

copy.offeracceptance.choose_this_offer_t.english: Choose this offer to continue to private direct-payment instructions. The price, clinician and time are checked again; confirmation requires the applicable payment and appointment approvals.

copy.offeracceptance.confirming_reserves.english: Confirming reserves this total from your balance. Adding funds does not hold the offer;eligibility and time are checked again.
copy.offeracceptance.confirming_reserves.amharic: ማረጋገጥ ይህን ጠቅላላ መጠን ከቀሪ ሂሳብዎ ይይዛል። ገንዘብ መጨመር አማራጩን አይይዝም፤ ጊዜና ብቁነት ዳግም ይረጋገጣሉ።
copy.offeracceptance.confirming_reserves.afaan_oromo: Mirkaneessuun maallaqa kana herrega kee irraa qaba. Maallaqa dabaluu qofaan dhiyeessichi hin qabamu;gahumsii fi yeroon deebiʼanii mirkanaaʼu.

copy.pwaupdatenotice.a_teletena_update_i.english: A TeleTena update is ready. Refresh when you have finished what you’re doing.

copy.shared_ui_copy.find_clinicians_book.english: Find clinicians, book a session, and keep your care connected.

copy.shared_ui_copy.check_the_issuing_au.english: Check the issuing authority yourself. Record the source, actual check date, source reference and uploaded license document. A source reference identifies the registry record or your documented check; it is not a password. Do not mark a credential verified merely because a file was uploaded.

copy.shared_ui_copy.use_the_professional.english: Use the professional name your credentials are issued under.

copy.shared_ui_copy.no_services_match_th.english: No services match this search. Try another term.

copy.shared_ui_copy.approve_only_when_al.afaan_oromo: Sakatta’iinsaa fi ragaan dirqamaa yoo guutaman qofa hayyami. Galmeen yoo dhabame odeeffannoo gaafadhu; ulaagaan yoo hin guutamne didi.

copy.shared_ui_copy.your_resume_is_share.english: Your resume is shared with the reviewer. Attach a License or registration PDF to each scope for credential verification. Additional qualification or training evidence supports the individual review.
copy.shared_ui_copy.your_resume_is_share.amharic: የሥራ ልምድ ሰነድዎ ለገምጋሚው ይቀርባል። ለማረጋገጫ የፈቃድ PDF ከእያንዳንዱ ማመልከቻ ጋር ያያይዙ። ተጨማሪ የብቃትና ስልጠና ማስረጃ ግምገማውን ይደግፋል።
copy.shared_ui_copy.your_resume_is_share.afaan_oromo: CV kee gamaaggamaaf qoodama. Mirkaneessaaf PDF hayyamaa iyyata tokkoon tokkootti maxxansi. Ragaan barnootaa fi leenjii dabalataa gamaaggama ni deeggara.

copy.shared_ui_copy.learn_the_main_contr.english: Learn the main controls without changing any records.
copy.shared_ui_copy.learn_the_main_contr.afaan_oromo: Galmee tokko illee osoo hin jijjiirin to’annoo ijoo baradhu.

copy.shared_ui_copy.guidance_for_this_wo.english: Guidance for this workspace. Help never submits a form or records a decision.
copy.shared_ui_copy.guidance_for_this_wo.amharic: ለዚህ የሥራ ቦታ መመሪያ። እገዛ ቅጽ አያስገባም ወይም ውሳኔ አይመዘግብም።
copy.shared_ui_copy.guidance_for_this_wo.afaan_oromo: Qajeelfama bakka hojii kanaa. Gargaarsi unka hin ergu ykn murtii hin galmeessu.

copy.shared_ui_copy.use_this_guide_while.english: Use this guide while reviewing. All final decisions remain human decisions.
copy.shared_ui_copy.use_this_guide_while.amharic: በግምገማ ወቅት ይህን መመሪያ ይጠቀሙ። ሁሉም የመጨረሻ ውሳኔዎች በሰው ይወሰናሉ።
copy.shared_ui_copy.use_this_guide_while.afaan_oromo: Gamaaggama keessatti qajeelfama kana fayyadami. Murtiin xumuraa hundi kan namaa ti.

copy.shared_ui_copy.finish_the_current_p.english: Finish the current protected step before starting a tour. You can still read help here.
copy.shared_ui_copy.finish_the_current_p.amharic: ጉብኝቱን ከመጀመር በፊት ያለውን ደረጃ ያጠናቅቁ። እገዛውን እዚህ ማንበብ ይችላሉ።
copy.shared_ui_copy.finish_the_current_p.afaan_oromo: Daawwannaa jalqabuu dura tarkaanfii ammaa xumuri. Gargaarsa asitti dubbisuu dandeessa.

copy.shared_ui_copy.application_review_p.english: Application review, private evidence, credential checks, scope decisions and correction workflows.
copy.shared_ui_copy.application_review_p.amharic: የማመልከቻ ግምገማ፣ የግል ማስረጃ፣ ማረጋገጫ፣ ውሳኔና እርማት ሂደቶች።
copy.shared_ui_copy.application_review_p.afaan_oromo: Gamaaggama iyyataa, ragaa dhuunfaa, mirkaneessa, murtii fi adeemsa sirreeffamaa.

copy.shared_ui_copy.license_evidence_is_.english: License evidence is missing for this scope. A resume is not license evidence. Choose Request information so the applicant can upload a License or registration PDF and resubmit.
copy.shared_ui_copy.license_evidence_is_.amharic: ለዚህ አገልግሎት የፈቃድ ማስረጃ ጎድሏል። የሥራ ልምድ ሰነድ የፈቃድ ማስረጃ አይደለም። አመልካቹ የፈቃድ PDF እንዲጫንና እንደገና እንዲያስገባ መረጃ ይጠይቁ።
copy.shared_ui_copy.license_evidence_is_.afaan_oromo: Ragaan hayyamaa tajaajila kanaaf hin jiru. CV ragaa hayyamaa miti. Iyyataan PDF hayyamaa olkaa'ee deebi'ee akka ergu odeeffannoo gaafadhu.

copy.shared_ui_copy.evidence_references_.english: Evidence references beside assessment scores are optional. License evidence for credential verification is required before approval.
copy.shared_ui_copy.evidence_references_.amharic: ከነጥቦች ጎን ያሉ የማስረጃ ማጣቀሻዎች አማራጭ ናቸው። ከማጽደቅ በፊት የፈቃድ ማስረጃ ያስፈልጋል።
copy.shared_ui_copy.evidence_references_.afaan_oromo: Wabiiwwan ragaa qabxii biratti filannoo dha. Mirkaneessa hayyamaaf ragaan hayyamaa hayyama dura barbaachisa.

copy.shared_ui_copy.approval_needs_a_lic.english: Approval needs a license document attached to this scope, a verification source, check date and source reference. Request information if the document is missing.
copy.shared_ui_copy.approval_needs_a_lic.amharic: ለማጽደቅ ከዚህ ማመልከቻ ጋር የተያያዘ የፈቃድ ሰነድ፣ ምንጭ፣ የማረጋገጫ ቀንና ማጣቀሻ ያስፈልጋሉ። ሰነዱ ከጎደለ መረጃ ይጠይቁ።
copy.shared_ui_copy.approval_needs_a_lic.afaan_oromo: Hayyamaaf galmee hayyamaa iyyata kanatti maxxane, madda mirkaneessaa, guyyaa sakatta'iinsaa fi wabii barbaachisa. Galmeen yoo dhabame odeeffannoo gaafadhu.

copy.shared_ui_copy.choose_a_license_or_.english: Choose a License or registration document uploaded to this service application.
copy.shared_ui_copy.choose_a_license_or_.amharic: ወደዚህ ማመልከቻ የተጫነ የፈቃድ ወይም ምዝገባ ሰነድ ይምረጡ።
copy.shared_ui_copy.choose_a_license_or_.afaan_oromo: Galmee hayyamaa ykn galmee iyyata kanaaf olkaa'ame filadhu.

copy.shared_ui_copy.clear_the_unfinished.english: Clear the unfinished credential check before requesting information, or complete it and confirm verification after checking the source.
copy.shared_ui_copy.clear_the_unfinished.amharic: መረጃ ከመጠየቅ በፊት ያልተጠናቀቀውን ማረጋገጫ ያጽዱ፤ ወይም ምንጩን ፈትሸው ማረጋገጫውን ያጠናቅቁ።
copy.shared_ui_copy.clear_the_unfinished.afaan_oromo: Odeeffannoo gaafachuu dura sakatta'iinsa hin xumuramne qulqulleessi; ykn madda sakatta'uun mirkaneessa xumuri.

copy.shared_ui_copy.enter_a_valid_creden.english: Enter a valid credential check date that is not in the future.
copy.shared_ui_copy.enter_a_valid_creden.amharic: የወደፊት ያልሆነ ትክክለኛ የማረጋገጫ ቀን ያስገቡ።
copy.shared_ui_copy.enter_a_valid_creden.afaan_oromo: Guyyaa sakatta'iinsaa sirrii kan gara fuulduraa hin taane galchi.

copy.shared_ui_copy.complete_every_asses.english: Complete every assessment score and rationale before approving this scope.
copy.shared_ui_copy.complete_every_asses.amharic: ይህን አገልግሎት ከማጽደቅ በፊት ሁሉንም ነጥቦችና ምክንያቶች ይሙሉ።
copy.shared_ui_copy.complete_every_asses.afaan_oromo: Tajaajila kana hayyamuu dura qabxii fi sababoota madaallii hunda guuti.

copy.shared_ui_copy.general_application_.english: General application approval does not grant service-scope approval.
copy.shared_ui_copy.general_application_.amharic: አጠቃላይ የማመልከቻ ፈቃድ የአገልግሎት ፈቃድ አይሰጥም።
copy.shared_ui_copy.general_application_.afaan_oromo: Hayyamni iyyataa waliigalaa hayyama tajaajilaa hin kennu.

copy.shared_ui_copy.a_mandatory_assessme.english: A mandatory assessment has not passed. Request information or decline; scores cannot replace required evidence.
copy.shared_ui_copy.a_mandatory_assessme.amharic: አስፈላጊ መስፈርት አልተሟላም። መረጃ ይጠይቁ ወይም ውድቅ ያድርጉ፤ ነጥቦች አስፈላጊ ማስረጃን አይተኩም።
copy.shared_ui_copy.a_mandatory_assessme.afaan_oromo: Madaalliin dirqamaa hin darbine. Odeeffannoo gaafadhu ykn didi; qabxiin ragaa barbaachisaa hin bakka bu'u.

copy.shared_ui_copy.the_service_definiti.english: The service definition needs medical-lead approval before a clinician can be approved for it.
copy.shared_ui_copy.the_service_definiti.amharic: ባለሙያው ከመፈቀዱ በፊት የአገልግሎት መግለጫው የሕክምና መሪ ፈቃድ ያስፈልገዋል።
copy.shared_ui_copy.the_service_definiti.afaan_oromo: Ogeessi hayyamamuu dura hiikni tajaajilaa hayyama hoogganaa yaalaa barbaada.

copy.shared_ui_copy.the_credential_has_e.english: The credential has expired. Request current evidence before approval.
copy.shared_ui_copy.the_credential_has_e.amharic: የማስረጃው ጊዜ አልፏል። ከማጽደቅ በፊት ወቅታዊ ማስረጃ ይጠይቁ።
copy.shared_ui_copy.the_credential_has_e.afaan_oromo: Yeroon ragaa darbeera. Hayyama dura ragaa yeroo ammaa gaafadhu.

copy.shared_ui_copy.patients_choose_a_pu.english: Patients choose a published appointment time

copy.shared_ui_copy.choose_how_appointme.english: Choose how appointments can be booked. These choices do not enable immediate care without its separate review.
copy.shared_ui_copy.choose_how_appointme.amharic: ቀጠሮዎች እንዴት እንደሚያዙ ይምረጡ። እነዚህ ምርጫዎች ያለ ተለየ ግምገማ ፈጣን እንክብካቤን አያነቁም።
copy.shared_ui_copy.choose_how_appointme.afaan_oromo: Beellamni akkamitti qabamu filadhu. Filannoowwan kun gamaaggama addaatiin alatti kunuunsa hatattamaa hin banan.

copy.shared_ui_copy.choose_how_appointme.english: Choose how appointments can be booked. Consultation, notes and summary requirements belong under Required platform workflows.
copy.shared_ui_copy.choose_how_appointme.amharic: ቀጠሮዎች እንዴት እንደሚያዙ ይምረጡ። የምክክር፣ ማስታወሻና ማጠቃለያ መስፈርቶች በመድረክ የሥራ ሂደቶች ስር ናቸው።
copy.shared_ui_copy.choose_how_appointme.afaan_oromo: Beellamni akkamitti qabamu filadhu. Ulaagaaleen marii, yaadannoo fi cuunfaa adeemsa waltajjii keessatti galmaa’u.

copy.shared_ui_copy.set_both_session_len.english: Set both session length limits, with the minimum no greater than the maximum.
copy.shared_ui_copy.set_both_session_len.amharic: ሁለቱንም የምክክር ርዝመት ገደቦች ያስገቡ፤ ዝቅተኛው ከከፍተኛው መብለጥ የለበትም።
copy.shared_ui_copy.set_both_session_len.afaan_oromo: Daangaa dheerina marii lamaan kaa’i; xiqqaan guddaa caaluu hin qabu.

copy.shared_ui_copy.clinicians_apply_for.english: Clinicians apply for each service separately. Upload private documents in Professional review, save the draft, then submit. If information is requested, open the application, correct it and resubmit. Approval is always manual.
copy.shared_ui_copy.clinicians_apply_for.amharic: ባለሙያዎች ለእያንዳንዱ አገልግሎት ለየብቻ ያመለክታሉ። በሙያ ግምገማ የግል ሰነዶችን ጫኑ፣ ረቂቁን አስቀምጡና አስገቡ። መረጃ ከተጠየቀ ማመልከቻውን ክፈቱ፣ አስተካክሉና እንደገና አስገቡ። ፈቃድ ሁልጊዜ በሰው ይወሰናል።
copy.shared_ui_copy.clinicians_apply_for.afaan_oromo: Ogeessonni tajaajila tokkoon tokkoof addaan iyyatu. Gamaaggama ogummaa keessatti galmee dhuunfaa olkaa’i, wixinee olkaa’iitii ergi. Odeeffannoon yoo gaafatame iyyata bani, sirreessiitii deebi’ii ergi. Hayyamni yeroo hunda namaan murtaa’a.

copy.shared_ui_copy.the_end_date_must_be.english: The end date must be on or after the effective date.
copy.shared_ui_copy.the_end_date_must_be.amharic: የመጨረሻ ቀን ከመጀመሪያ ቀን ጋር እኩል ወይም ከዚያ በኋላ መሆን አለበት።
copy.shared_ui_copy.the_end_date_must_be.afaan_oromo: Guyyaan xumuraa guyyaa jalqabaa irratti ykn booda ta’uu qaba.

copy.shared_ui_copy.enter_a_valid_effect.english: Enter a valid effective date or leave the optional date empty.
copy.shared_ui_copy.enter_a_valid_effect.amharic: ትክክለኛ የመጀመሪያ ቀን ያስገቡ ወይም አማራጭ ቀኑን ባዶ ይተዉ።
copy.shared_ui_copy.enter_a_valid_effect.afaan_oromo: Guyyaa jalqabaa sirrii galchi ykn guyyaa filannoo duwwaa dhiisi.

copy.shared_ui_copy.select_only_approach.english: Select only approaches you are trained to use. Your evidence is reviewed separately.
copy.shared_ui_copy.select_only_approach.amharic: ለመጠቀም የሰለጠኑባቸውን ዘዴዎች ብቻ ይምረጡ። ማስረጃዎ በተለየ ይገመገማል።
copy.shared_ui_copy.select_only_approach.afaan_oromo: Maloota itti fayyadamuuf leenjite qofa filadhu. Ragaan kee addaan gamaaggamama.

copy.shared_ui_copy.no_reviewed_approach.english: No reviewed approaches are available to select yet. You can still submit your service application.
copy.shared_ui_copy.no_reviewed_approach.amharic: ለምርጫ የተገመገሙ ዘዴዎች ገና የሉም። የአገልግሎት ማመልከቻዎን ማስገባት ይችላሉ።
copy.shared_ui_copy.no_reviewed_approach.afaan_oromo: Maloonni gamaaggamaman filachuuf ammatti hin jiran. Iyyata tajaajilaa kee erguu dandeessa.

copy.shared_ui_copy.if_an_approach_is_no.english: If an approach is not listed, describe your training below. Selecting an approach does not grant approval.
copy.shared_ui_copy.if_an_approach_is_no.amharic: ዘዴው ካልተዘረዘረ ስልጠናዎን ከታች ይግለጹ። ዘዴ መምረጥ ፈቃድ አይሰጥም።
copy.shared_ui_copy.if_an_approach_is_no.afaan_oromo: Malli hin tarreeffamne yoo ta'e, leenjii kee armaan gaditti ibsi. Mala filachuun hayyama hin kennu.

copy.shared_ui_copy.these_previous_entri.english: These previous entries are not selectable catalog approaches. Move them to your training description or remove them before saving.
copy.shared_ui_copy.these_previous_entri.amharic: እነዚህ የቀድሞ ግቤቶች ሊመረጡ የሚችሉ ዘዴዎች አይደሉም። ከማስቀመጥዎ በፊት ወደ ስልጠና መግለጫ ያንቀሳቅሱ ወይም ያስወግዱ።
copy.shared_ui_copy.these_previous_entri.afaan_oromo: Galteewwan duraanii kun maloota filataman miti. Olkaa'uu dura gara ibsa leenjii geessi ykn haqi.

copy.notification_or_default_public_copy.english:
Internal Review Draft
A medical/legal lead must define the retention schedule, lawful grounds, deletion exceptions, custodians and jurisdictions before production. This draft supplies process boundaries, not invented retention periods.

Classification and Requests
Classify account, professional evidence, clinical, consent, financial, audit and backup records separately. Verify requester identity and authority. Record requests and decisions without copying clinical text into general logs.

Disclosures and Deletion
Distinguish revocation of future access from historic disclosure and record retention. Do not erase immutable encounter snapshots, financial postings, consent history or audit evidence to make a request appear fulfilled. Escalate conflicts and legal holds for authorized decision.

Access and Backups
Least privilege applies to custom and generic APIs, files, reports and exports. Clinic membership does not grant record access. Backup access must be restricted; restoration must preserve security and consent records. Approved retention periods and backup expiry remain pending.

copy.notification_or_default_public_copy.english:
Internal Review Draft
Assign responsible security, clinical and legal contacts, coverage and jurisdiction-specific notification duties before production. This is editable operational boilerplate.

Triage and Containment
Record a neutral incident reference, time, affected system and authorized investigator. Restrict access, preserve relevant evidence and credentials securely, and contain a suspected exposure without broadcasting patient data. Do not log tokens, OTPs or raw clinical bodies.

Assessment and Response
Assess safety, confidentiality, integrity and availability impacts with least privilege. Credential verification and clinical safeguarding decisions remain human-led. Confirm applicable legal reporting and individual notification obligations with counsel; this template supplies no unsupported deadline.

Recovery and Learning
Use verified backups and scoped service procedures. Check record/consent and owner financial reconciliation after recovery. Document decisions, communications, corrective action and authorized closure. Never treat a provider acknowledgement as proof that an individual received a safety message.

copy.notification_or_default_public_copy.english:
Review Status and Operator
This editable review template describes the implemented demonstration controls. It is not a claim of legal compliance. The real controller/operator, privacy contact, lawful grounds and jurisdiction-specific notices must be confirmed before real care.

Information Used
Accounts use verified contacts and profile details. Optional history text and private files, professional applications, bookings, requests, encounter disclosures, records and demonstration transaction references serve their stated workflows. Do not provide real clinical information in this review environment.

Purpose and Limited Sharing
Public discovery exposes allowlisted approved profile and offering information only. Open-request recipients see only the authorized request disclosure. The chosen treating clinician receives the immutable encounter disclosure you approve, including individually selected files. Partners, clinics, reviewers and other clinicians do not receive blanket clinical-record access.

Choices and Consent
Name, alias, text history and individual files are separate choices. Defaults can be edited. A global preference is not consent to unknown recipients. Terms acceptance, privacy acknowledgement, care consent and optional marketing are separate records. Revoking future access cannot erase what a recipient previously viewed or automatically settle clinical retention duties.

Providers and Cross-Border Processing
Configured SMS, email and LiveKit services support authentication, neutral notices and calls. Provider acceptance is not proof of delivery. Before production the operator must identify actual providers, hosting locations, transfers, safeguards and contracts. No recording or transcription is enabled by default.

Security and Browser Storage
Private files and clinical APIs require server authorization. Authentication and clinical responses are not cached by the service worker. Guest health drafts stay in tab memory and are lost on refresh; safe opaque navigation intent may be retained. No platform can promise absolute security.

Retention and Individual Requests
Retention periods, deletion exceptions, legal holds, access/correction processes and regulator routes require local governance approval. Contact the configured privacy channel to request review. This template does not invent deadlines or permit silently deleting financial history or disclosed clinical records.

Incidents and Changes
Report suspected unauthorized access through the configured channel without sending clinical material in a general message. Authorized staff must assess containment and applicable notification duties. New document versions preserve earlier acceptance records; policy editing is not a retrospective consent change.

copy.notification_or_default_public_copy.english:
Review Template
This information supports, but does not replace, encounter-specific informed consent and professional assessment. Qualified clinical/legal review is required.

Remote Care and Suitability
Audio/video care may be unsuitable for some needs. Connection or device failure may interrupt care. Do not use open requests for emergencies. Discuss suitability, alternatives, risks and limitations with the clinician.

Your Participation
Confirm a private setting and who is present. You may leave a call; leaving is not clinician completion. Each adult in a couples session must accept their own invitation, disclosure and applicable time/extension proposals. Declined or withdrawn consent restricts participation according to the application state.

Information Shared
Review name/alias, history text and each selected file before encounter authorization. Private notes and a patient-shared summary are separate. A partner does not automatically receive your private intake or all summary content.

Time and Charges
Paid extensions require explicit required-participant consent and authorized payer funds before they begin. Connection duration alone is not billing consent. The demonstration involves no real payment or clinical care.

copy.notification_or_default_public_copy.english:
Review Template
This explanation does not change operational booking policy. Exact accepted price, confirmation mode, expiry and cancellation rules are snapshotted by the booking workflow.

Confirmation and Expiry
An automatic booking may confirm when the protected transaction succeeds. A manual booking stays pending until the clinician responds. A single three-minute email reminder is distinct from the snapshotted confirmation-expiry deadline. Notifications can fail without undoing a valid booking.

Cancellation and Time Changes
Use supported in-app pre-start cancellation or mutual rescheduling. Existing restrictions remain; elapsed appointments are not automatically completed. No-show adjudication and automatic no-show penalties are outside this MVP. Unsupported post-release refund cases need authorized resolution.

Funds and Earnings
Booking reserves demonstration funds. Clinician finalization consumes the reservation once and creates pending earnings under its snapshotted fee/withholding policy. Ending a call alone does not settle. Disputes hold eligible release; payout requests reserve available earnings without implying external transfer.

Production Decisions
Real provider arrangements, mandatory consumer rights, complaint deadlines and refund obligations need explicit legal/provider approval before real-money activation. No payment details should be sent through public enquiries.

copy.notification_or_default_public_copy.english:
Review Status
This is editable demonstration boilerplate. It is not an approved agreement for real patient care. The legal operator, governing law, jurisdiction, liability provisions and dispute process require qualified local review before activation.

Purpose and Eligibility
TeleTena helps adults aged 18 or older discover published services, request private offers, book consultations and access authorized records. Open requests are not an emergency response service. Clinician approval is a human platform review, not regulatory accreditation or a guarantee of treatment results.

Accounts and Responsibilities
Use your own verified contact and protect your account. Do not impersonate another person, upload unlawful material or attempt unauthorized access. Professional access requires current general and service-specific approval. Navigation intent does not grant a professional role.

Bookings and Requests
Published services show duration, format and price. A request or offer does not reserve a slot. The application rechecks availability, approval, disclosure and funds before booking. Manual confirmation remains pending until accepted. An immediate matching target is not a guarantee.

Demonstration Funds
This environment uses demonstration balances only. A reservation is distinct from a charge, pending earnings, release and payout reservation. No real custody, external transfer, refund or payout is represented by these demonstration events. A future real-money service needs separately approved arrangements and terms.

Consultations and Records
Joining, leaving, ending a call and finalizing documentation are separate actions. Notes are private unless a deliberately shared summary is authorized for you. Each adult participant gives individual consent; paying does not grant another person's records.

Changes, Cancellation and Complaints
The policy snapshot shown at booking governs supported cancellation, confirmation expiry, rescheduling and extensions. Do not assume an automatic refund or no-show penalty. Use the configured support channel for an authorized review. Editing this document does not alter past appointments or policy snapshots.

Before Production
The operator must complete legal identity, contact, pricing, complaint deadlines, consumer rights, jurisdiction and enforcement provisions with counsel. Mandatory rights are not waived by this review template.

copy.notification_or_default_public_copy.english:
Review Template
Contact details in this environment are fictional unless replaced by an authorized reviewer. Do not send urgent or clinical information to a mock channel.

Getting Help
Use account Help & Tours for navigation and the configured support channel for account or booking problems. Provide a neutral booking reference and concise issue description, not passwords, OTPs, private notes or medical attachments.

Review and Escalation
An authorized operator should acknowledge, investigate and record outcomes with least-privilege access. Financial dispute review does not authorize private clinical notes. Actual response deadlines, appeal routes and independent escalation must be agreed before production.

Urgent Safety
TeleTena is not emergency care. Contact local emergency services or a nearby emergency department if immediate safety is at risk. The operator must validate local crisis/safeguarding contacts and clinical escalation procedures before real care.

copy.notification_or_default_public_copy.english:
Proposed Review Standards
These editable standards require medical-lead and legal approval. They are not a substitute for licensing rules or a representation that a regulator has accredited TeleTena.

Professional Responsibility
Provide truthful qualifications, evidence, current license/registration details where applicable and service-specific competence. Platform reviewers must distinguish applicant claims from verified evidence. Affiliation alone is not clinical competence.

Scope and Conduct
Offer only currently approved services within restrictions, population, language, format and jurisdiction. Do not imply approval for all scopes from general application acceptance. Explain limitations, suitability, fees and disclosure choices professionally.

Records and Boundaries
Protect private documents and encounter-specific notes. Share summaries only with explicitly authorized recipients. Do not record without an approved separate process. Report credential expiry, scope restrictions, safety concerns and potential confidentiality incidents to authorized reviewers.
